title: wg: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §MLS Messages: scope the 'MUST reject a Message/set update that changes body' rule to the provider role
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 §MLS Messages (message/mls): 'The server MUST reject a Message/set update that changes body, bodyType, or reactions of a Message in a Chat with a roomId with an invalidProperties SetError.' Read literally it binds any JMAP Chat server whose Chats carry roomId, including a converting party (mimid's agent) that holds plaintext and maps an owner's edit to a MIMI edit per §Edits and draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Editing a Message. The intent is the provider role, whose roomId Chats hold application/mimi-fanout Messages. Suggest: 'A server acting as MIMI provider for the account (this capability) MUST reject ...', or say that a converting party maps such an update to MIMI content with replaces. mimid follows reading (b), decision mimid-1wgh.65 item 7.
